Both John and Tony also perform well on the field, backing up Derek Thorogate whose Discus throw of 139'7" in the County Champs was worth a new Club Record (Yths) and a bronze medal.
Jim Vivian was our only winner on the track but Derek Thorogate took both of the field events with good distances from classy opponents who were several years older than himself.
Derek Thorogate gained us our first medals of the meeting by placing 3rd in both the Youth shot and Discus. His Shot Putt mark was 47'9½" whilst his discus reached 139'7" .
In the last issue of the 'Belgravian' we mentioned that Derek Thorogate's discus throw of 139'7", during the Surrey Youth Championships, was a Youths Club Record.
